reviews.text: Absolutely love this salon! From the moment you walk in, everyone is welcoming and professional, and the atmosphere is beautiful, clean, and relaxing. The quality of both the hair and nail services is outstanding. They pay close attention to detail, use quality products, and always make sure you leave feeling your best. Every visit is a wonderful experience,I’m been doing my nails with Lupita for 2 years and she’s the best also my hair with Sylvana since 2021.I highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for exceptional hair and nail services!

Great ladies! Awesome people and dedication to all the ladies! Also, Awesome coffee! I give thanks to these beautiful ladies: Ana, who styles my hair weekly; Lupe, her beautification in doing my monthly pedicure and manicure. Andrea, with her amazing technique in eyebrows. Jackie with her contagious smile and out of sight work. Janet, the newest staff who proves her gifts in hair styling. Patricia, constantly making sure all clients are well taken care of and the awesome coffee and hospitality she offers. Overall, Sylvana for making a relaxing place to gather and leave your worries behind. It's a day when I'm a true Dominican woman, not forgetting my roots and the appreciation to be accepted. Thank you, ladies!!!

Great atmosphere, everyone is attentive, informative, & friendly. All the stylists work hand on hand to give the best quality and services for each client. Sylvana is great when it comes to quality in her work along side the other stylists in which helps the salon move at a steady pace !
My daughter and myself have been clients here for 3 years receiving haircuts, deep conditioning, blowouts and styles !
